description: A hospital department administrator must assign the hospital's only mobile bariatric lift to either the North or South inpatient unit and finalize its configuration, staffing, and cleaning plan, with input from physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one mobile bariatric lift available for immediate assignment.
shared_context.S2: Both the North and South inpatient units have patients whose transfer plans are being reviewed for use of the lift.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has authority to assign the lift and approve the associated operational plan.
shared_context.S4: Hospital policy requires Morgan to hold a brief equipment-readiness check with physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention before finalizing the assignment.

PF1.text: The South unit patient failed the sit-to-stand assessment and requires a full-body bariatric lift for every bed-to-chair transfer; the North unit patient can currently complete a two-person stand-pivot transfer with a gait belt, according to Dr. Chen's therapy assessment.

PF2.text: The available lift is the Titan-MB model, and its 48-inch turning radius fits South room 412's 50-inch doorway; North room 318 has a 36-inch doorway and cannot safely accommodate this lift. The charger must therefore be placed in the South 4B equipment alcove.

PF3.text: Three South-unit nurses have completed the lift competency validation, and hospital policy requires two validated staff members for every lift transfer; their available coverage is 07:00-19:00 daily.

PF4.text: Because the South unit patient is on contact precautions, the lift plan requires a dedicated extra-large sling labeled for South room 412 and a documented disinfecting wipe-down after each transfer.

acceptance_conditions: The mobile bariatric lift must be assigned to the South unit.
The Titan-MB lift model must be specified.
The charger must be placed in the South 4B equipment alcove.
Two validated South-unit staff members must be scheduled for transfers from 07:00-19:00 daily.
A dedicated extra-large sling labeled for South room 412 must be specified.
A disinfecting wipe-down after every transfer must be documented as a commitment.
The therapy assessment requiring the South patient to use a full-body lift must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['staffing_window'] == '07:00-19:00 daily' and any('two validated staff members' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: 'extra-large sling' in decisions['sling_specification'] and 'South room 412' in decisions['sling_specification']
content_checks.C6: any('disinfecting' in c['detail'] and ('after each transfer' in c['detail'] or 'after every transfer' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The therapy assessment changes the assignment from an open choice between North and South to South because its patient requires a full-body lift while the North patient can use a two-person stand-pivot transfer.
The equipment record changes the plan to the Titan-MB model and changes the charger location to the South 4B equipment alcove because North room 318 cannot accommodate the lift.
The competency record changes staffing to two validated South-unit staff members for every transfer during the exact 07:00-19:00 daily window.
The precautions assessment changes the sling specification to a dedicated extra-large sling labeled South room 412 and adds the exact after-each-transfer disinfecting commitment.
